resolved.title: 数据类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dictionaries[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Python provides a number of built-in [b]collection types[/b], to store multiple values.

[b]Lists[/b] are one of these collection types, and they allow you to store indexed values:[code format="py" codeId="3102"]x = ['hi', 'hello', 'welcome']
 print(x[2])[/code]
Each item of a list has an index, which is automatically set.

[b]Dictionaries [/b]are another collection type and allow you to map arbitrary keys to values.
Dictionaries can be indexed in the same way as lists, using [b]square brackets[/b] containing keys.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="359"]ages = {
   "Dave": 24,
   "Mary": 42,
   "John": 58
}
print(ages["Dave"])
print(ages["Mary"])[/code]
[note]Each element in a dictionary is represented by a [b]key:value[/b] pair.[/note]

content.text:
Python提供了许多内置的**数据类型**，用来存储多个值。

列表是python中的一种数据结构,序列中的每一个元素都对应的索引

列表代码如下:
content.text_html:
Python provides a number of built-in collection types, to store multiple values.

Lists are one of these collection types, and they allow you to store indexed values:

Python提供了许多内置的集合类型，用来存储多个值。

Lists是这些集合类型中的一种，它们允许你存储索引值。

content.text:
列表中的每个元素都有一个索引，这个索引是自动设置的。

> 记住：索引从0开始

**字典**是另一种集合类型，允许你将任意的键映射到值。
字典也可以通过索引访问，类似列表相同，使用包含键的**方括号**。

代码如下:
content.text_html:
Each item of a list has an index, which is automatically set.

**Dictionaries **are another collection type and allow you to map arbitrary keys to values. Dictionaries can be indexed in the same way as lists, using square brackets containing keys.

Example:

列表中的每个项目都有一个索引，这个索引是自动设置的。

字典是另一种集合类型，允许你将任意的键映射到值。 字典的索引方式与列表相同，使用包含键的方括号。

例子：

content.content:
ages = {"Dave": 24, "Mary": 42, "John": 58}

# 访问键 Dave 的值
print(ages["Dave"])
# 访问键 Mary 的值
print(ages["Mary"])

content.text: 字典中的每个元素都由一个**键:值**对表示。
content.text_html:
Each element in a dictionary is represented by a key:value pair.

字典中的每个元素都由一个key:value对表示。

resolved.title: 数据类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dictionaries[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Only [b]immutable [/b]objects can be used as keys to dictionaries. [b]Immutable [/b]objects are those that can't be changed. 
So far, the only mutable objects you've come across are [b]lists [/b]and [b]dictionaries[/b]. [code format="py" codeId="361"]bad_dict = {
  [1, 2, 3]: "one two three", 
}[/code]
Since lists are mutable, the code above throws an error.

[note]This means that you can use strings, integers, booleans, and any other immutable type as dictionary keys.[/note]

resolved.title: 访问汽车数据
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设汽车的数据都存储在一个字典中，如：

```python
car = {
    'brand':'BMW',
    'year': 2018,
    'color': 'red
}
```

编写程序需要输入某个键并输出相应的值。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dictionaries[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working at a car dealership and store the car data in a dictionary:[code format="py" ]car = {
    'brand': 'BMW',
    'year': 2018,
    'color': 'red'
} [/code]
Your program needs to take the key as input and output the corresponding value.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
year

[b]Sample Output[/b]
2018

[note]The data is already defined in the code.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 数据已经在代码中定义。
